account.title: Spider Grills account
account.description: Log in with your Spider Grills email and password. Your password is not stored; Home Assistant keeps the session token the Spider Grills app also uses.

select_device.title: Select device
select_device.description: Choose the Spider Grills device to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Spider Grills needs you to log in again. (Upgrading from v0.2 also requires this, because Spider Grills turned off the old AWS connection.)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Spider Grills cloud.
error.invalid_auth: Spider Grills rejected the email or password.
error.no_devices: No Spider Grills devices were found on this account.
error.device_missing: This device is no longer on that Spider Grills account.
